definitions.explanation: Costs that remain constant regardless of how much is produced or sold. Includes things like rent, insurance, and salaries. Used in both business accounting and personal finance contexts.

examples.japanese: {固定費|こていひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧。
⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧や⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固定費|こていひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Rent and insurance premiums are included in fixed costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固定費|こていひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Just by reviewing your monthly fixed expenses, you can save a considerable amount per year.

notes:
Used in both corporate accounting and personal finance. In personal finance contexts, {固定費|こていひ} typically refers to monthly bills that stay roughly the same: rent, loan payments, insurance, subscriptions, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固定費|こていひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to reduce fixed costs
- {固定費|こていひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review fixed expenses
- {固定費|こていひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion of fixed costs
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固定費|こていひ}: monthly fixed expenses

EXAMPLES OF FIXED COSTS:
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent
- ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧: insurance premiums
- ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧: loan payments
- ⟦サブスクリプション→サブスクリプション：08617_sabusukuripushon⟧: subscriptions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{変動費|へんどうひ}→変動費：26290_hendouhi⟧: variable costs — costs that fluctuate (food, utilities, entertainment)
